name: WORLD_CORE_V11_3_CONDITIONAL_CONTINUATION

scope.allowed_domain: E02-E03 population and labour cross-engine invariant validation only

dependency_exception.effect: Permits a non-production V11.3 implementation candidate only. It does not change Gate B evidence, authorize a main merge, or convert a missing operational test into PASS.

adr_cut_line.ADR-04: PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; V11.3 may require every cross-engine fact to carry an explicit caller-selected time/snapshot label but may not choose current, prior, opening, or phase ordering.
adr_cut_line.ADR-08: PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; V11.3 may validate exact evidence links but may not introduce a labour, wage, participation, matching, price, or rounding formula/default.
adr_cut_line.permitted_without_new_adr: Pure validation may prove that explicit E02/E03 facts conserve population and labour/skill stock, use compatible snapshot labels, and cannot create labour or skill without an approved source fact.

preserved_controls: V11.3 remains IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED until an immutable candidate receives its required independent review.
V11.2 owner acceptance is a continuation decision, not a main merge, deployment, production or Gate B approval.
No main merge, deployment, production/shared-Supabase access or mutation, migration publication, or original EconMind website change is authorized.
No V12 or later product implementation may use this record.
Any failed mandatory V11.3 test or newly discovered P0/MAJOR finding stops this continuation.

applicable typecheck, lint, boundary, governance, secret, and build checks
